_note: Ranges are [low, mid, high]. Sources are public benchmarks gathered in October 2026; 'assumption' means no direct source and should be validated with real data.

installs_per_day.source: Indie developer blogs and forums: ~12/day for a hyper-casual case, 'rarely more than 200-500 organic per day'. Low confidence.

ad_impressions_per_dau.source: Assumption, weakly supported: a single unverified source quotes 5-8.

ecpm_usd.source: Derived assumption: Europe Android rewarded ~$8.9, interstitial $3.6-5.3, banner <$2 (Playio 2026); blended mix with no direct figure.

remove_ads_purchase_rate.source: Paying conversion in mobile games 1.5-3.5% of actives (2026 blog). The low value is an assumption for a remove-ads-only offer.

store_fee.source: Google Play: 15% on the first USD 1M per year (enrolment required).

paid_cpi_usd.source: Cost per paid install, casual games, Android, Western Europe: industry blog (2026) without a clear primary source. Low confidence.

tooling.source: AI coding assistant subscription tiers, European prices including VAT.

self_employed_fee.source: Spanish self-employed social security: reduced flat rate for the first 12 months, then from ~EUR 206.

apple_developer.source: Apple Developer Program, USD 99 per year; only needed for iOS.
